title: A1 Swaara v1.0.4 - Swaara Connect, Studio Master Visualizer & Smart Stash
changelog:
- Swaara Connect: Seamless cross-device audio handoff & remote control between Android, Windows PC, and Web
- Studio Master Visualizer: 60 FPS hardware/procedural Neon FFT Spectrum, Fluid Waveform, Dual Analog VU needle meters, and Master DAC telemetry
- Analog Tube Warmth & Real-Time Karaoke Vocal Suppressor DSP toggles inside Studio Master mode
- Autonomous Smart Stash: Silent background precaching of top rotation tracks when on unmetered Wi-Fi and charging
- Verified 12.84 MB R8-optimized release package
